stem:
As line AB rotates about line AC in space, keeping an angle of 30°, what figure is traced out by the line AB?

[Image: Line AB intersecting line AC]
figure_description: Two straight lines intersect at point A. One line is horizontal with arrows at both ends, containing point A and labeled C below its right end. The other line passes through A, slanting upward to the right and downward to the left, with arrows at both ends; point B is marked on the upper-right ray. An angle arc between ray AB and ray AC is labeled 30°.
